note: User-facing (operator) acceptance scenarios. The technical gate asks whether the loop is disciplined; this gate asks whether a user can do their job with the product. Every scenario states what a user observes and why it matters. Expectations below were measured by hand against sample-service at e477477 before being written down (probes answer 200, metrics serves Prometheus text, an invalid port is refused with exit 1 naming the field, SIGTERM ends the process in ~250 ms).

scenarios.title: the process starts with a local env and binds the probes listener
scenarios.why: an operator cannot use the product at all if it does not come up on a documented configuration

scenarios.title: /healthcheck answers 200 while the database is disabled
scenarios.why: liveness must not depend on a database, otherwise an operator without Postgres sees a dead service

scenarios.title: /readiness answers 200 with POSTGRES_ENABLED=false
scenarios.why: readiness gates traffic; a false negative here takes the service out of rotation for no reason

scenarios.title: /metrics serves Prometheus text
scenarios.why: operators monitor the service; a metrics endpoint that answers non-Prometheus content is silent blindness

scenarios.title: the API listener is bound and answers on the documented port
scenarios.why: the API port must be owned by this process (no business routes exist in this phase, so 404 is the documented answer, not a hang or a connection refusal)

scenarios.title: SIGTERM shuts the process down cleanly within 2 s
scenarios.why: a service that ignores SIGTERM is killed hard by its supervisor, dropping in-flight work

scenarios.title: an invalid configuration is refused loudly with a non-zero exit
scenarios.why: an operator typo must fail at startup with the offending field named, not start a half-configured service

scenarios.title: the published v1 contracts validate their valid bundle and reject the invalid ones
scenarios.why: the contracts are the product's external interface; a fixture that no longer validates means a breaking change shipped, and a fixture that should be rejected but is not means the interface accepts garbage
